The '''Repulsor Grappling Gun''' was a [[Grappling Gun|grappling gun]] produced by [[Zone Control]].

The grappling gun was unique in that the main body of the grappling hook was powered by a small [[repulsorjet]], allowing for the hooks rate of ascent and direction to be controlled by a small joystick set into the launcher itself. The launcher was rifle sized, and contained 200 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] of molecularly reinforced line, as well an automatic winch capable of pulling 200 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]] at 20 meters per [[Standard second|second]].

Alternatively, a wrist mounted version operating off of hand commands existed, containing a spool of 100 meters of line, and a miniaturized winch capable of lifting 150 kilograms 10 meters per second. Both rifle and wrist versions were powered through [[Power cell/Legends|power cells]], with the hook itself recharging when fully withdrawn.
